key_insight: OmniShow unifies text, reference images, audio, and pose as joint conditioning signals to generate temporally coherent, high-fidelity human–object interaction videos, enabling fine-grained control over both human motion and object behavior in a single model.
problem_solved: Current HOI video generation methods cannot simultaneously accept and fuse the full set of practical controls (text, image, audio, pose), leading to limited controllability, inconsistent object-hand interactions, and poor temporal coherence for real-world applications like product demos and short-form content.
method: Multimodal encoder + fusion: Encode text, reference image(s), audio, and pose into a shared representation and fuse via cross-attention modules to produce unified conditioning.
Temporal generation backbone: Use a temporal-aware video generator (e.g., transformer/diffusion-based) that enforces frame-to-frame consistency and preserves object-hand contact dynamics.
Object- and pose-aware rendering: Inject object-centric constraints and explicit pose conditioning during decoding to maintain plausible interactions and visual fidelity.
impact: Provides a practical, unified solution for controllable HOI video synthesis, lowering the bar for automated content creation in e-commerce, social media, and entertainment while giving researchers a template for multimodal conditioning in temporal generative models.
